card.name: Digits and spots before years or numbers
card.fires_on: Mostly the first digit of a number or year in news-style web text, or the space just before a year. It also appears on a few scattered small words in news and legal prose.

modes.label: Start of a number or year
modes.description: The first digit of a price, rate or year such as 1.35, 1000 or 2009.

modes.label: Space before a year
modes.description: The space between a date and the year that follows.
modes.example: NOVA: Who Killed Lindbergh’s Baby? Airs Wednesday, January 30,<< >>2013 at 9 p

modes.label: Scattered small words
modes.description: Small words in news or legal prose, such as is, to or the.
modes.example: The United States has become accustomed<< to>> its hegemonic military presence in the greater

card.writes: It suppresses words meaning recently, such as recently, lately and recent, so it steers away from "recently" after a number or date.
card.plain: It fires on the opening digits of years and figures in news text, and it makes words like "recently" less likely next.
